content.value: Suppose a person have two iricome options (per month): to earn \$ 75 US from home based freelancing and working at an office for \$ 140 US (ignore time cost).If one way transportation to office costs \$ 0.25 US/km at 5 km distance, and considering 25 days office days a month, explain his/her decision to accept employment between two options. Also explain, how will his/her decision change in the following conditions:
(i) Suppose the office offers transportation cost \$ 30 US per month (ignore time cost);
(ii) Suppose it takes 1 hr to reach office and time cost is \$ 0.10 US/hr.
(C) Why do large cities have higher incomes?
